instruction: Set the font color of the titles in slides 1, 3, and 4 to red and apply bold formatting.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing title colors to red (RGB 255,0,0) and making them bold in slides 1, 3, and 4 (0-indexed: 0, 2, 3). Evaluator reads the presentation file and checks if the title text formatting matches the expected color and bold properties. Partial credit is given per slide: each slide contributes equally to the final score.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks both required properties: title color (red RGB 255,0,0) and bold formatting for slides 0, 2, 3
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('slides'), expected.get('color'), etc. without incorrectly nesting under 'rules' key
Postconfig properly saves the file with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure changes are persisted
Partial credit logic is correctly implemented - each slide contributes equally to final score
Color comparison uses exact RGB tuple matching which is appropriate for this task
Bold property comparison correctly handles None/False equivalence for 'not bold' states
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Title detection uses first text shape rather than specifically checking for title placeholder types. Consider using shape.placeholder_format or checking shape.shape_type to identify actual title placeholders, as this would be more robust if slides have text boxes positioned before titles
The getter could add error handling for cases where slides have no text shapes at all, returning explicit empty/null values rather than skipping the slide entirely
